[placeholder] "Rift Basin" is the overview's title, not an approved name.

Act I region. A closed (endorheic) rift basin modelled on the Danakil Depression / Dallol, about 100 km rim to rim, and drying: "the basin is drying" is the act's thread. Escarpment and highlands to the west and north-west, with the raised north rim running on past the volcano; the city's upper city on a shelf in the escarpment directly above its Slums, at the foot of the falls; mineral washes and the Ruined Outpost mid-basin; basalt to the north under an active volcano; fossil reef terraces and gypsum stepping east to the salt flats and brine pools; localized acid pits at the south of the floor; the Dead Spring to the south.

The city (P28). The city holds the only graded caravan road onto the plateau and the last reliable water, a thin, shrinking stream; its power is those two, not fertile land. Arid farming only: small stone-terraced fields along the stream on the plateau, date palms along the falls, failing as the stream shrinks. Food is topped up by caravan, paid for in salt (and sulfur) cut by captives on the pan and at the acid field and carried up the escarpment road; that is why captives are brought here. The act's exit is up through the city onto the plateau. Who buys the salt beyond the plateau, and the boss, are open.

Fugitives (P30). Slums residents are free citizens; slavers take only escaped slaves, the wanted and fugitives. Nothing keeps a fugitive safe there except laying low and evading the slavers; the protagonist is not branded or marked.

Act I spine (2026-11-13). Escape captivity, refuge in the Slums, pursue promised passage beyond the region, betrayal and slaver ambush, the route sealed behind, several upper-city zones, the Act I boss, passage into Act II. The way forward is through the city. Staging of the betrayal is provisional.

Locked: zone 01 is the caravan escape tutorial (combat); zone 02 is the Slums, the safe quest hub (no combat). Anchors: Slums, upper city (4-6 combat maps for the finale), Acid Pits, destroyed ruins, captive-caravan intro.

Provisional: about 15-20 playable maps. The working 19-section scaffold groups them as 01 caravan escape, 02 Slums hub, 03-04 ruined road and ruins, 05-06 iron-stained washes, 07-08 basalt, 09-10 fossil terraces and gypsum, 11-12 salt flat and brine margin, 13-14 acid pools, 15-19 upper-city ascent to the final fight. Order, names and routes between zones are undecided; each zone is an ARPG tileset, so the map draws no zone-to-zone paths.

Exaggerated for play: the pools, the lava lake and the Dead Spring are 10-100 times their real size, so they read on the map and in the zones (G36). [provisional] What feeds the falls: springs where the plateau's groundwater meets the master fault (W2).
